cases.request_round_id: authoritative current RFQ request round UUID or null

requirements: Read-only, service-only function; verify ownership of every case, draft, intent, linked message and quote. Do not expose internal tables to Data API.
Use one database snapshot for round, successful sends and verified reply evidence. Return exactly one row per requested owned case; reject unknown or foreign cases.
Current round must come from authoritative RFQ workflow/intent state. Do not equate extraction current_batch_id with RFQ round or infer a round by newest timestamp.
sent_supplier_ids contains only suppliers with RFQ purpose and SENT success evidence in the current round; exclude DRAFT, SENDING, FAILED and UNKNOWN.

valid_reply_supplier_ids contains only suppliers with a verified valid quote reply linked to the same owner, case and current RFQ send/round. Header link alone, BUSINESS classification, thread identity or receipt time alone is not proof of a valid quote reply.

Uncertain or ambiguous links and invalid/unconfirmed quote replies are excluded. Valid supplementary replies count once with their original supplier. Outbound and initial request mail never count as replies.
No RFQ round returns null plus two empty arrays. Missing infrastructure must error, never pretend there are no requests.

Return IDs only: no body, subject, email address, attachment contents or tokens. No writes, sidebar aggregate, per-case frontend request or new logs. API returns the intersection of replied suppliers and successfully requested suppliers.
DB v3.6 deduplicates case IDs in first-input order. Null arrays/elements are invalid; at most 100 inputs. Empty input yields cases: [].
A VALID quote reply is evidence of a response, not purchase feasibility. A 15kg MOQ reply to a 10kg request still counts if otherwise a verified valid quote.
Current-round SENT suppliers must contain every valid reply supplier. Contract violations fail rather than silently hiding inconsistent evidence.
Legacy sends without an explicit RFQ round remain unmodified and return null plus empty arrays. No automatic backfill.
Gmail provider message ID is not RFC Message-ID. Delayed headers must not reduce SENT denominator. Ambiguous links require actual user confirmation before assess_rfq_reply.
SQL open_rfq_round accepts CANDIDATES/GENERATING_PLANS/WAITING_REPLY, not extraction stop step SELECTING_CANDIDATES. Candidate orchestration must explicitly bridge stages; do not bypass the DB guard.
Full v3.6 SQL reviewed locally. No remote SQL execution, supplier seeding, mail sending or approval performed during development.
Direct mail_drafts INSERT uses SQL draft_chain and rfq_draft_current guards and deterministic intent-derived draft identity. No RFQ evidence table is inserted by server code.
Automatic send requires a completed matching CANDIDATE run and current policy fingerprint matching creation. Approval-ON drafts never become automatically eligible by switching policy OFF.

Sender accepts only authorized=true DB claims, makes one provider POST, stores SENT only with provider ID, and records ambiguous provider outcomes UNKNOWN. A lost finish acknowledgement never triggers another send.

No supplier data leads to NEEDS_INFO without an LLM call. No past prices or contact addresses are sent to the selection model. Commercial RFQ text is rendered from stored case facts, not model-invented terms.

22023.scope: internal caller supplied an invalid argument

complete_rfq_outbound_metadata.body_text: not required; SQL stores empty outbound body

server_implementation.metadata_worker_start: Starts with the connected-mailbox worker, no switch. Owners are read from mail_sync_states every cycle; claims stay per owner. Missing RFQ schema logs a warning and leaves it off.
server_implementation.producer_call_site: Connected-owner worker scans SQL CANDIDATES (and legacy SELECTING_CANDIDATES); scoped candidate run, round and complete draft preparation gate all sending.
server_implementation.sending_rule: No server switch. Sending follows per-user send settings (unset/approval/auto) and Gmail send scope. One shared server per DB.
server_implementation.approval_http_api: API-16 list, API-17 detail, API-19 atomic approval/202, API-20 durable read-only reconciliation/202 are implemented. Requires local migration 002 to be reviewed/deployed by DB owner.
server_implementation.interrupted_preparation: Three-minute preparation deadline plus run fences; recover_rfq_server atomically fails five-minute-old runs and matching active case. No automatic reexecution.
server_implementation.interrupted_sending: Five-minute-old SENDING becomes UNKNOWN, never FAILED or resent. API-20 reads exact sent evidence; absence stays UNKNOWN.

verification.http_principal: mocked; real Supabase JWT flow not reverified

server_implementation.candidate_policy: Exact normalized item handling evidence; known specification mismatch excluded; model selects only server-proven IDs; mandatory unknowns requested in RFQ; no invented prices or contacts.
server_implementation.draft_wording: Server-rendered commercial facts and confirmation questions; effective signature/tone snapshot. Selection prompt cannot author or change commercial amounts.

http_contract.settings_version: Opaque string returned by GET; not a local numeric counter.
http_contract.snapshot_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 byte-length-framed immutable draft fields; shared Python/SQL implementation.
http_contract.idempotency: Single SQL transaction claims request, approves or enqueues reconciliation, stores first 202 envelope. Nonblocking request lock returns REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS.

database_definitions: Managed in Supabase by the DB owner; backend ships no SQL installation files.
